meta.low_paid: LODES earnings bands SE01 + SE02: $3,333 a month or less
meta.note: Primary jobs (JT01), home block to work block, including Colorado jobs held by people who live in another state and Colorado residents whose job is in another state; those homes and jobs are named by county. Distances are straight-line; roads are longer. LODES assigns some workers to an employer main office, so long distances include some people who do not make that trip daily. Places with fewer than 200 primary jobs are left out.
